name: Galestorm
description:
Upon Hero kill, gain a 20% boost to movement speed, for 10 seconds. 

Must land killing blow to activate.
explanation: This perk is decent, and an alternative to other perks due to its generic usefulness on many assassin heroes. Helps rotations from one finished fight to the next, although executing the opponent eats into the duration of the buff.

name: Devourer
description:
Executions heal an extra +10 HP. 

Healing occurs at the kill time of the execution.
explanation:
This perk is especially good on heroes with strong dash heavies who can punish rolls (e.g Warden, Shaman, PK). 

Synergizes extremely well with Remedy and Head Hunter, providing Shaolin and Shaman a potent perk setup. 

Has extra value on heroes with executions that have quick kill times. Post-nerf it heals the same amout as Remedy, making it strictly worse than that perk.

name: Early Reaper
description:
Upon spawn or revive, your next attack deals 30% extra damage. 

Applies to chip damage from blocked attacks, landed attacks, and damage dealing feats - against heroes or soldiers.
explanation:
This perk is awful, as is its logical equivalent, Crush Them, as they both have a small single use benefit that isn't even guaranteed to work.

The best use is to boost the damage of high damage ranged feats, which can be easier to hit off spawn when you arrive at a fight.

name: Endurance
description:
Gain a 3% stamina cost reduction per renown level. 

Maximum 12% stamina cost reduction at max renown.
explanation:
This perk is decent, and is an acceptable alternative to Head Hunter due to its generic utility. Great for characters who use zones or high stamina moves in their 4v4 gameplay.

Note: Does not stack with the feat: tireless.

name: Survival Instinct
description: When in critical health ( <25 HP), gain a 25% stamina cost reduction.
explanation: This perk is very underwhelming, and encourages you to attack when you are low on HP, a situation where you would rather be turtling up to obtain revenge.

name: Crush Them
description:
Upon Hero kill, your next attack deals 30% extra damage.

Applies to chip damage from blocked attacks, landed attacks, and damage dealing feats - against heroes or soldiers.
explanation: This perk is awful, as is its logical equivalent, Early Reaper, as they both have a small single use benefit that isn't even guaranteed to work. The best use is to boost the damage of high damage ranged feats, immediately after a kill, like a worse version of Bloodlust.

name: Head Hunter
description: For each unique Hero executed, maximum health is increased by +4 HP to a maximum of +16 HP.
explanation: This perk is decent, and is an acceptable alternative to Endurance. Synergizes extremely well with Remedy and Devourer to give you increased value out of execution healing.

name: Aegis
description:
All shields received are boosted by 20%. Applies to shields given by feats, perks, boosts, and revenge. 

Note that revenge shields can never exceed your max health.
explanation:
This perk is very mediocre in general, but is more justifiable in Breach where shields are more prevalent. 

Because revenge shield can never exceed your maximum health, you won't even get the full 20% extra shield unless you have >144 health, making this perk near enough useless for many characters

name: Shields Up
description:
Upon revive, gain a +25 HP shield that lasts for 15 seconds. 

(Also triggered by the Auto Revive feat)
explanation: Post nerf, this perk has essentially been dumpstered - as not only is the situation you can get the shield in far less frequent, it will likely run out before you actually get into combat again.

name: Bastion
description:
When in a zone, or carrying an offering/banner, gain 10% damage resistance. 

Zones include capture points in Dominion, and archer points, healing zones, and near the ram in Breach.
explanation: Beneficial for stalling in Dominion. Extremely practical in Breach, where the Healing Zone, nearby ram, and archer lane are all considered objectives.

name: Vengeful Barrier
description: When exiting revenge, gain a +25 HP shield for 15 seconds.
explanation:
This perk is easily the best defense perk, and rewards you even more for obtaining revenge. A must-have for any character with it available.

The addition of a timer for the shield duration is hardly a nerf, as you're normally still fighting when you exit revenge.

name: Last Stand
description: When in critical health ( <25 HP), gain 40% damage resistance.
explanation:
This perk is quite good, with frequent debates about using it or Bulk Up, the perk combos incredibly well with Vengeful Barrier and shield feats, as they do not count towards the critical health threshold, giving you a massive amount of damage reduced health. This perk doesn't synergise too well with Bastion or Hard to Kill, considering that damage resistance does NOT stack.

The perk is only triggered once you are actually at critical health, so attacks that would kill from above critical health will not be reduced, (eg. a 30 damage heavy will still kill you from 30 hp) although this is less of a downside now that attacks do less damage overall.	

The damage resistance provides an effective ~10HP boost once you are in critical, but the mental play of 40% damage resistance should not be ignored, as many players will neglect to try calculate their reduced damage, leading to them feeding revenge in an attempt to finish you off - allowing the script to be easily reversed.

name: Fresh Focus
description: When out of stamina, blocks, parries, and counter guard breaks recover 20% stamina.
explanation:
This perk is decent, and a decent alternative to Endurance. It has been buffed to give stamina back on a CGB when OOS, as well as blocks and parries. 

Can now be very useful to relieve OOS pressure from bash/GB mix-ups, as well as from characters whose OOS pressure comes from fast follow-up attacks after a blocked light (eg. chain 400ms lights, light -> bash mix-ups etc)

name: Bulk Up
description:
Gain +4 HP maximum health per renown level. 

Maximum +16 HP at max renown level.
explanation:
A consistent and reliable health increase, this perk is pretty good, with it's only downside being that you typically have to choose between this and Last Stand.

This perk doesn't synergise with the revenge shield bug, but does allow for more riskier plays/trades with the extra +16 HP.

name: Radiant Rebound
description: Upon spawn or revive, gain a 20% boost to movement speed for 10 seconds.
explanation:
This perk is very good in Dominion on heroes who clear the minion/soldier lane, and allows you to get there at the start of a game faster than heroes who do not have the perk.

The ability to rotate quickly from spawn should not be underestimated, especially with the removal of defender renown. Stalling on an enemy's point is incredibly easy with this perk.

name: Remedy
description: Upon Hero kill, gain +10 HP. Must land the final hit to count.
explanation: This perk is decent because of its generic use, and usually because alternatives are simply inferior. Synergizes extremely well with Head Hunter and Devourer to give you an increased value out of execution healing.

name: Feline Agility
description:
Gain +4% movement speed when reaching renown level 1, and +2% for each subsequent level. 

Maximum +10% movement speed at max renown level.
explanation: This perk is very mediocre due to the low movespeed bonuses and being gated by renown level, which is especially a concern in Dominion. Not terrible, but outshined by many other feats typically.

name: Supersonic
description:
In revenge, gain +15% movement speed and uninterruptible sprint. 

This remains active for 10s after revenge ends.
explanation: This perk is fairly mediocre despite giving you a free escape route in most scenarios. It is outshined by feats that more directly synergize with playstyles of heroes who can use it.

name: Clever Tactics
description:
Capture zones and use banners/offerings 15% faster. 

Zones affected are capture points in Dominion, and archer points and healing zones in Breach.
explanation: This perk is pretty useless in Dominion, and can be useful for heroes who like to play the Archer lane in Breach. Typically outshined by other available perks.

name: Rising Dawn
description: Revive allies to 75% HP. (Instead of 50%)
explanation:
This perk is good, especially on heroes with revive-related feats (e.g Speed Revive and Protected Revive). Valuable in Breach, as HP is a commodity.

Providing an extra 25% on all revives makes them somewhat worth-while in Dominion, meaning that you could try to get more renown from revives.

name: Rapid Refresh
description:
Upon hero takedown (kill or assist), or when reviving an ally, all feat cooldowns are reduced by 5%. 

Applies to active feats, and passive feats that have cooldowns.
explanation: This perk is arguably the best in the game (besides Vengeful Barrier with the revenge shield bug), but is only available to a small amount of heroes. Greatly benefits these heroes if they use feats with cooldowns, rather than passives, allowing for more uses of their actual feats.
